svg.text: netmon · home network & endpoint security monitoring
Hermes agent · Security Onion · Elastic · UniFi · Claude · local LLM
Overview · Risk · Fix list · Endpoints · Lateral map
Web Push urgent notifications · per-user device subscriptions
Semgrep · Bandit · ESLint · Trivy · Gitleaks · ZAP
• Elasticsearch is queried read-only; netmon never changes Security Onion, UniFi or the network.
• Nightly: Claude triages findings with web research; report.py renders the PDF (downloadable in the dashboard).
• Every 15 min: deterministic watcher → alerts table → Web Push to subscribed users. Nothing is posted to chat.
